composed_answers.field: Attach a message for the employer (Introduce yourself)
composed_answers.text: Hi — I'm a full-stack developer who ships end-to-end. Solo, I designed, built and deployed a commercial self-service printing platform to production in three months: a React 19 / TypeScript frontend on a cloud Python/.NET backend, with payments, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and a passed public-institution security audit. On the Python side I have two years of scientific-software development (a computational library used by a whole research group, plus HPC automation), hands-on LLM integration into applications, and daily work with REST APIs, PostgreSQL/SQL, pytest and Git. My Python web APIs have so far been built on FastAPI rather than Flask, but the REST/service patterns transfer directly and I pick up frameworks quickly. Given the project's mix of data transformation, AI-driven automation and financial-sector compliance, I'd bring both the AI/data background and a security-minded, get-it-done mindset. English C1. GitHub: https://github.com/yanlukashevich · Portfolio: https://drukmruk.pl
